name: watnow
description: WATnow: all your Learn deadlines in one side panel. Chrome and Firefox builds from one source.

scripts.lint:ff: node tools/pack.mjs firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.build:ff: node tools/pack.mjs firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest --filename watnow-firefox-{version}.zip
scripts.build:chrome: node tools/pack.mjs chrome && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest --filename watnow-chrome-{version}.zip
